title: Rams' Quentin Lake texted apology to Chargers Justin Herbert for ham-handed 'deli meat' comment

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Rams' Quentin Lake texted apology to Chargers Justin Herbert for ham-handed 'deli meat' comment
sources.description: Rams safety Quentin Lake texted Chargers quarterback Justin Herbert to apologize after saying on a podcast that Herbert was 'throwing deli meat' and 'seeing ghosts' during Sunday's game.
